interpretation_note: A positive SHAP value raises the model's malware score relative to the baseline; a negative value lowers it. Attributions explain this model on the labelled ficheiro_final.csv corpus, not ground-truth maliciousness. creation_time and Permissions are reported but excluded as collection artifacts.
